# The check inventory

scout runs **81 checks** across **9 phases**.

80 of those are fixed, and 1 is a family whose id is built at run time —
one check per value the run encounters, marked `*` below.

This file is generated from the source: every check is created through
`(*Session).check(id, title)`, and this table is those call sites. CI fails
when it drifts, so the figure scout publishes is the figure it implements.

A check may be reached from more than one branch — a handshake can fail in
several ways and report the same id. The count is of distinct ids, because
that is what a reader sees in a report.
